newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank-100 mln dmk boost from tax deal in 97.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank-100 mln dmk boost from tax deal in 97.

text.p: Germany's Commerzbank AG stands to add some 100 million marks to its earnings this year as a result of having resolved its dispute with tax authorities over back-tax repayment, sources said on Monday.

Sources in Frankfurt banking circles told Reuters the bank had built up more than sufficient reserves to cover the tax payout and would be now able to dissolve around 100 million marks in reserves this year, which could be declared as extraordinary income.
The tax dispute began last year after a raid on Commerzbank premises, which triggered demands for it to pay back several hundred millions of marks in back-tax for the 1984 to 1994 period.
Commerzbank has been disputing the level of the repayment but said earlier on Monday it had reached a deal with tax officials.
